economy.summary: His campaign platform supports raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage, saying no one working full-time in Pennsylvania should be living in poverty, and commits to lowering household utility costs.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage; commits to lowering utility costs.

taxes.summary: Says he would reform the school funding model to remove the burden from fixed-income seniors and local school districts, shifting more education costs to the state.
taxes.short: Proposes school-funding reform to ease burden on seniors, districts.

abortion.summary: Said in a podcast interview that he supports reproductive freedom and access to abortion, and criticized efforts to ban reproductive rights.
abortion.short: Supports reproductive freedom and access to abortion.

education.summary: Calls for increased state funding for public education, saying current funding does not cover state mandates that burden local school districts.
education.short: Supports increased state funding for public education.

healthcare.summary: Says he would work to expand healthcare access and expand Medicaid coverage.
healthcare.short: Supports expanding healthcare access and Medicaid coverage.

energy.summary: Proposes investing in renewable energy sources, requiring data centers to generate their own power, and lowering electricity prices.
energy.short: Proposes renewable investment, data-center power requirement, lower electricity prices.

guns.summary: His campaign materials do not detail a gun policy; he has proposed using revenue from legalizing adult-use cannabis to hire more law enforcement officers.
guns.short: No stated gun policy; proposes cannabis revenue for police hiring.

economy.summary: Says making life more affordable for families is a focus of her campaign; supports eliminating taxes on tips and overtime pay and points to a tripled child tax credit and property tax relief passed during her tenure.
economy.short: Supports ending taxes on tips, overtime; cites affordability record.

taxes.summary: Co-announced a 2025 legislative package to exempt everyday items from the state sales tax, with her bill exempting pet food; she said the exemption would help young families and seniors with costs.
taxes.short: Proposes sales-tax exemption for pet food to limit costs.

abortion.summary: Said in 2022 she would protect access to safe and legal abortion in Pennsylvania and backs current state law; in 2021 she voted for legislation requiring health facilities to cremate or inter fetal remains after a miscarriage or abortion.
abortion.short: Says she backs current Pennsylvania abortion law, protecting access.

education.summary: Points to the passage of record state funding for public schools during her tenure as an accomplishment she cites in seeking another term.
education.short: Cites record public school funding passed during her tenure.

healthcare.summary: Says she advocates reforming the healthcare system to prioritize patient needs and affordability, and supports passing family leave and medical leave.
healthcare.short: Advocates healthcare reforms for affordability; supports family, medical leave.

guns.summary: Her platform emphasizes public safety rather than a stated gun policy: she supports funding for local law enforcement and adding more police officers, and sponsored bills making looting a second-degree felony and strengthening protections for stalking victims.
guns.short: Supports police funding, more officers; no stated gun policy.
